messages:
sara_sales: Hey @mike_legal @anita_procurement — Novara sent back the MSA + DPA with a handful of redlines. Can we get a quick triage? They want signature routing + a PO issued before EOW.

mike_legal: I pulled the markups. Top items: SLA credits (they want 99.95 with 10% credit cap), termination-for-convenience 60-day notice, and broader indemnity language for data use.

anita_procurement: Procurement also flagged billing. Novara requires invoice sent to billing@novara.com and a PO# on every invoice. They asked about EFT vs wire.

sara_sales: FYI we promised a POC with EU data residency and private VPC. Devin, can you confirm the POC topology so legal knows what to expect?

devin_engineering: Confirmed — POC will be in eu-west-1, dedicated tenant, no cross-region replication. We'll enable KMS-backed keys (customer-managed). ETA to stand up environment is Tue.

mike_legal: KMS note helps. On DPA: they added 'data portability within 30 days' and 'audit rights' more expansive than our standard. Suggest we counter: 45 days for export, scoped audit requests via SOC2 report first.

anita_procurement: Also, they want a 12 month service credit lookback and a separate SLA for throughput/latency on batch embedding jobs. Do we have standard language for rate/throughput SLAs?

sara_sales: We don't usually offer throughput SLA to customers at this tier. Can sales offer a one-time uplift to a Dedicated preview if they need throughput guarantees?

devin_engineering: Throughput SLA is tricky. For dedicated we can promise baseline throughput for committed GPU units; need to model expected qps. If they sign dedicated, ops needs 2-week lead time.

mike_legal: Draft counterpoints I'll propose: keep uptime SLA at 99.9 with tiered credits, remove the separate throughput SLA (proposal to handle via Dedicated order form), limit audit requests to SOC reports unless there's a material incident, and change portability window to 45 days.

anita_procurement: For signature routing: Novara needs DocuSign signature from their CFO and ours. Who owns sending? Sales or Legal? Also procurement wants a ship-to/bill-to section on the order form and PO# field.

sara_sales: I can initiate DocuSign once legal signs off on redlines. Anita can you confirm billing contact and whether they need W-9/Tax form?

anita_procurement: They said they are a US entity and requested W-9. I'll collect PO# and tax info.

secbot: [automated] SOC 2 Type II report uploaded to secure share: https://internal-storage/redwood/soc2/2025-type2.pdf

mike_legal: I'll circulate a marked PDF with our counter edits this afternoon. Suggest we map each redline to an acceptance/alternative so sales can discuss tradeoffs with Novara.

sara_sales: Perfect — once legal posts counters I'll start DocuSign routing. If procurement gets PO and W-9, we can aim for signature + PO before Friday. :crossed_fingers:

anita_procurement: noted. I'll ping Novara buyer for PO and confirm EFT vs wire preference.

devin_engineering: One more note for legal: POC resource constraints — we'll cap concurrent sessions to X during POC. I'll add numbers to the POC doc to avoid scope creep.

sara_sales: Great. Next steps: Mike drafts legal counters, Anita pulls PO/W-9, Devin updates POC doc, I handle DocuSign routing after signoff. Ping here if anyone needs changes. :thumbsup:
